status: partial prepared implementation; not versioned or published as 1.72
findings: Previous suspicious diagnostic logging wrote raw path/method/address/error values. A valid percent-encoded newline in an HTTP path could become a forged extra log line.

Forwarded-header-derived stdout sampling retained a growing map of arbitrary keys; junk-file logging had no shared rate bound. Spoofing forwarding headers could bypass stdout sampling and grow memory.
scope: Quote and byte-bound all untrusted diagnostic fields, excluding query strings, Authorization and Cookie headers.
Canonicalize actual transport peer and display forwarding claims separately as reported_ip, without trusting them as authority or throttle keys.
Bound stdout peer-map cardinality to 4096 with bounded keys and periodic expired-entry reclamation. A disabled per-peer cooldown retains no new keys.
Both diagnostic sinks share twenty initial records and one record/second refill. Count suppression on the next record; no new line or allocation retained per suppressed request.
Leave durable session/administrator journals, gameplay and credential admission untouched. Document diagnostic sampling and the remaining retention/proxy limits.

checks.coverage: Canonical IPv4/IPv6 and malformed forwarding claims; peer-map cap/expiry/rewind/large-key bounds; disabled cooldown; 100 concurrent contenders with exactly20 initial admissions and80 counted suppressions; saturated counter; escaped size-bounded fields and excluded credential/query headers; 100 spoofed forwarding claims cannot grow the peer map or bypass file limits; real loopback HTTP encoded-newline request cannot forge another log line.
checks.retained: Focused registration, credential work, token ownership, bootstrap/admin-role, origin and inbound-policy checks pass. Opt-in disposable Mongo integration fixtures are skipped in this invocation; the previous final connected 1.71 receipt retains its own scope.

limits: No production configuration, DNS, proxy, log file, account, role or currency was mutated.
This is diagnostic sampling, not a player IP limiter. Behind a proxy the stdout cooldown can group that transport peer; no account admission is denied by this sampler.

The shared rate bound is not a disk quota or log rotation. Other log categories, malformed WebSocket floods, broader gameplay trust boundaries, dependency/secret review and infrastructure budgets remain unfinished.

No 1.72 publication or security certification. Predecessor1.71 still requires the owner recovery delivery/ownership decision and its ordered release. Prepared1.65–1.70 must first pass individual CI and public acceptance after corrected1.64.1.
